description: Feed face picks on parts into the joint card. Pass face_id from list_faces together with the key from that row (ids are only valid until the next remesh; a stale pair returns unknown_face). A cylindrical face becomes an axis pick, as a viewport tap does.

face_id.description: Face id from list_faces on that part (e.g. f7). Valid only until the next remesh; pass the key from the same list_faces row with the id.
Face id from list_faces on that part (e.g. f7). Valid only until the next remesh; pass the key from the same list_faces row with the id.

kind.description: Pick kind when key is explicit (concentric uses axis picks). part picks the whole part, for a fixed joint; it needs no face_id or key.

name: joint_pick
